summary: Re-verification (on CURRENT workspace HEAD 4ef9730) of PAT-removal + Rollback v2 Pillar-1, per founder Rule 7/C prior to 'Save to GitHub' push. Ran pytest suite (35/35 PASS in 44.79s) covering PAT rejection paths, connection-status honesty (no 500s, unreachable vs disconnected distinction), typed GithubAppAuthError with code app_installation_missing from services/pat_vault.get_repo_token + get_repo_token_or_error, admin gating on all 7 rollback2 endpoints (14 parametrized 401/403 cases), real R2 snapshot + preview + execute + attempts ledger + single-use preview_token enforcement, and drill blocked path. Additionally executed a LIVE end-to-end rollback drill against AUREM_DRILL_REPO=polarisbuiltinc-wq/aurem-rollback-testbed (installation 152797252): result='passed' in 12.7s, all 8 steps ok (config, seed_good_state, snapshot, ship_breaking_change, verify_broken, preview, execute_rollback, verify_restored), attempt rba_87423c8343c7428a in ledger with result='success' and verified=true, no ghp_/github_pat_/gho_/ghs_ leakage in drill response, /drills, or /attempts. PAT PATCH/verify/add paths return honest 400/422 rejections with 'PATs are no longer supported' messaging. No regressions vs prior 25/25 + 10/10 reports.
